system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, this is Mia Garcia. I recently placed a few orders, but I just got into gaming and realized I want to focus on that—and honestly, also on studying hard. So, I’d like to cancel or return everything that isn’t related to gaming. Can you help me with that? I’d prefer the refund to go to my PayPal if possible, but if not, my credit card is fine.

Hi Mia — I can help with that. First I need to verify your account. Please either

- give the email address on the account, or  
- give your full name (you already gave Mia Garcia) plus your ZIP code.

Once I find your account I’ll list your orders and identify which items look non‑gaming, then propose specific actions (cancel if the order is still pending; request a return if already delivered). I’ll also try to refund to your PayPal first (and use your credit card only if PayPal isn’t available) — please confirm that PayPal is your preferred refund method.

Please provide your email or ZIP code to continue.
Sure, my email is mia.garcia2723@example.com. And yes, PayPal is definitely my preferred refund method. Thanks for helping me out!
